blocks.content: 12.1 History — Practice Questions

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Provides targeted practice questions covering six major subjects specific to Gujarat state exams.
Encompasses state-level History, Geography, Economy, Polity, Culture, and Science & Environment.
Designed to reinforce domain-specific factual knowledge required for competitive testing.

blocks.content: Q1. Which Harappan site in Gujarat is known for having the world's oldest dockyard?

items: A) Dholavira   B) Lothal   C) Surkotada   D) Rangpur

blocks.content: Answer: B) Lothal
Q2. The Dandi March started from which city?

items: A) Porbandar   B) Bardoli   C) Ahmedabad   D) Navsari

blocks.content: Answer: C) Ahmedabad (Sabarmati Ashram)
Q3. Who founded Ahmedabad in 1411 CE?

items: A) Mahmud Begada   B) Ahmad Shah I   C) Akbar   D) Zafar Khan

blocks.content: Answer: B) Ahmad Shah I
Q4. Gujarat was formed as a separate state on which date?

items: A) November 1, 1956   B) January 26, 1960   C) May 1, 1960   D) August 15, 1947

blocks.content: Answer: C) May 1, 1960
Q5. Which Satyagraha of 1928 earned Vallabhbhai Patel the title 'Sardar'?

items: A) Kheda Satyagraha   B) Dandi March   C) Bardoli Satyagraha   D) Non-Cooperation Movement

blocks.content: Answer: C) Bardoli Satyagraha
Q6. Dholavira was inscribed as UNESCO World Heritage Site in which year?
Answer: D) 2021
Q7. The Solanki king who built Sahasralinga Lake was:

items: A) Mularaja I   B) Kumarpal   C) Siddharaj Jayasinh   D) Bhimdev I

blocks.content: Answer: C) Siddharaj Jayasinh
12.2 Geography — Practice Questions
Q8. Which district has the highest rainfall in Gujarat?

items: A) Kutch   B) Surat   C) Dang   D) Valsad

blocks.content: Answer: C) Dang
Q9. Gir National Park is located in which district?

items: A) Rajkot   B) Junagadh/Gir Somnath   C) Bhavnagar   D) Amreli

blocks.content: Answer: B) Junagadh/Gir Somnath (spans multiple districts)
Q10. The Indian Wild Ass Sanctuary is located in:

items: A) Gir, Junagadh   B) Narayan Sarovar, Kutch   C) Little Rann of Kutch   D) Dang forest

blocks.content: Answer: C) Little Rann of Kutch
Q11. Which is the largest district of Gujarat by area?

items: A) Banaskantha   B) Jamnagar   C) Kutch   D) Surendranagar

blocks.content: Answer: C) Kutch
Q12. Sardar Sarovar Dam is built on which river?

items: A) Tapi   B) Sabarmati   C) Mahi   D) Narmada

blocks.content: CHAPTER 12: PRACTICE QUESTIONS (GUJARAT-SPECIFIC MCQs)
Answer: D) Narmada
12.3 Economy — Practice Questions
Q13. Surat is known as the 'Diamond City' because:

items: A) Diamonds are mined here   B) 85–90% of world's rough diamonds are polished here   C) Diamond exports are highest   D) First diamond was found here

blocks.content: Answer: B) 85–90% of world's rough diamonds are polished here
Q14. Which crop is Gujarat the largest producer of in India?

items: A) Wheat   B) Rice   C) Groundnut   D) Tea

blocks.content: Answer: C) Groundnut (also Cotton in some contexts)
Q15. AMUL dairy cooperative is located in:

items: A) Ahmedabad   B) Anand   C) Vadodara   D) Gandhinagar

blocks.content: Answer: B) Anand
Q16. GIFT City (Gujarat International Finance Tec-City) is in:

items: A) Ahmedabad   B) Vadodara   C) Gandhinagar   D) Surat

blocks.content: Answer: C) Gandhinagar
Q17. India's first International Financial Services Centre (IFSC) is in:

items: A) Mumbai   B) Delhi   C) GIFT City, Gandhinagar   D) Bangalore

blocks.content: Answer: C) GIFT City, Gandhinagar
12.4 Polity — Practice Questions
Q18. How many seats does the Gujarat Vidhan Sabha have?
Answer: B) 182
Q19. The first Chief Minister of Gujarat was:

items: A) Narendra Modi   B) Madhavsinh Solanki   C) Dr. Jivraj Narayan Mehta   D) Chimanbhai Patel

blocks.content: Answer: C) Dr. Jivraj Narayan Mehta
Q20. How many Lok Sabha constituencies are there in Gujarat?
Answer: B) 26
12.5 Culture — Practice Questions
Q21. Patola silk sarees from Patan use which weaving technique?

items: A) Single ikat   B) Double ikat   C) Jamdani   D) Kashmiri weave

blocks.content: Answer: B) Double ikat
Q22. Which dance is performed during Navratri using decorated sticks?

items: A) Garba   B) Tippani   C) Dandiya Raas   D) Bhavai

blocks.content: Answer: C) Dandiya Raas
Q23. 'Vaishnav Jan To' bhajan was composed by:

items: A) Meera Bai   B) Narsinh Mehta   C) Akho   D) Premanand

blocks.content: Answer: B) Narsinh Mehta
Q24. The first Gujarati author to win the Jnanpith Award was:

items: A) Pannalal Patel   B) Raghuveer Chaudhari   C) Umashankar Joshi   D) K.M. Munshi

blocks.content: Answer: C) Umashankar Joshi (1967)
Q25. Rani ki Vav (Queen's Stepwell) is located at:

items: A) Modhera   B) Patan   C) Vadodara   D) Ahmedabad

blocks.content: Answer: B) Patan
12.6 Science and Environment — Practice Questions

items: State-specific History and Culture carry significant weightage in Gujarat competitive examinations.
Geography MCQs frequently test knowledge of Gujarat's rivers, coastline, soil types, and national parks.
Economy and Polity sections regularly feature Gujarat state schemes, budget highlights, and administrative structure.

blocks.content: Q26. The Physical Research Laboratory (PRL) is located in:

items: A) Gandhinagar   B) Surat   C) Vadodara   D) Ahmedabad

blocks.content: Answer: D) Ahmedabad
Q27. Which is the only habitat of Asiatic Lions in the world?

items: A) Ranthambhore, Rajasthan   B) Sariska, Rajasthan   C) Gir, Gujarat   D) Corbett, Uttarakhand

blocks.content: Answer: C) Gir, Gujarat
Q28. India's first Marine National Park is in:

items: A) Andaman Islands   B) Gulf of Mannar, Tamil Nadu   C) Gulf of Kutch, Gujarat   D) Lakshadweep

blocks.content: Answer: C) Gulf of Kutch, Gujarat
Q29. Gujarat was the first state in India to formulate a policy for which energy source?

items: A) Wind   B) Nuclear   C) Solar   D) Hydroelectric

blocks.content: Answer: C) Solar (Solar Power Policy, 2009)
Q30. Kakrapar Atomic Power Station is located on which river?

items: A) Narmada   B) Mahi   C) Sabarmati   D) Tapi

blocks.content: Answer: D) Tapi
